parsed.why: No trans-specific criminalisation or state targeting of visitors, but zero legal protection, official calls to exile trans people, carnival assault on a gay visitor, gay-panic acquittals, unsolved murders, underground visibility: hostile society with no recourse.

Decriminalised by Supreme Court, constitutional non-discrimination extended, 2024 harassment act naming gender identity, Pride, regional treaty blocking entry bans. Residual prohibited-immigrant statute and religious hostility are latent, enforcement unestablished: protections largely operative.

State-directed: deportation of foreign nationals suspected of being gay or trans without charge (2018-2022), app entrapment targeting trans women, coerced anal exams, morality-law arrests with prison terms, no anti-discrimination law, media incitement. Direct traveler exposure.

Universal exposures: passports forced to birth sex, visa refusal on sex doubt, foreign travel advisories, multi-state facility bans, one arrest held in men's ward, custody conversion policies. Offsets: no criminalisation, functioning courts, hate-crime and employment protections.

Decriminalised 1977, gender-identity discrimination and hate-speech law, Life Partnership, police-guarded Pride show state protection; but documented hostility, rock-throwing opponents, physical attacks on gender-nonconforming person, restrictive LGR. No traveler-facing criminal or state targeting.
